info.title: Find All ZIP Codes within a Radius - ZIP Code Radius Search API
info.description: Find all ZIP or postal codes within a given radius from a central ZIP code or GPS coordinates. Supports pagination with up to 500 results per page and multiple distance units (km, mi, yd, m, ft, in). The central point can be specified by ZIP code plus country, or by latitude/longitude coordinates. Returns code, region, city, district, and distance for each matching postal code within the radius, sorted nearest-first. Maximum radius is 100 km (or the equivalent in other units).

servers.description: ZIP Code Radius Search API Server

get.summary: Find ZIP/postal codes within a radius
get.description: Returns every ZIP/postal code within the given radius of a center point, specified either by code plus country or by latitude/longitude coordinates.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Postal/ZIP code to use as the center point for the search. Requires country to be set. Alternative to lat/long.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude coordinate for the center point. Alternative to code/country.

parameters.name: long
parameters.description: Longitude coordinate for the center point. Alternative to code/country.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Required only when using the code parameter.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius for the query. The maximum allowed values are: 100 km, 100 mi, 109361 yd, 100000 m, 328084 ft, 3937007.75 in.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Unit for the radius and returned distance values. Supported distance units are m, km, mi, ft, yd, in.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve. Each page returns up to 500 results.

200.description: ZIP/postal codes found within the specified radius

400.description: Bad Request — Missing/invalid radius, coordinates, or country code

InvalidRadius.summary: radius exceeds the maximum allowed for the given unit

value.message: The specified radius is out of the acceptable range. Please check the documentation for valid radius limits.

BadCountry.summary: country is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

404.description: Not Found — Base ZIP/postal code does not exist

BaseNotFound.summary: code is not a recognized postal/ZIP code

value.message: The provided base postal/zip code does not exist in our database.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

ZipcodeSearchRadiusResponse.description: ZIP code radius search result with pagination metadata and an array of matching codes within the specified radius.

total_results.description: Total number of ZIP/postal codes found within the radius, across all pages.

current_page_size.description: Number of ZIP/postal codes returned on the current page (up to 500).

results.description: Array of matching ZIP/postal codes for the current page, sorted nearest-first by distance.

ZipRadiusResultItem.description: A ZIP code result within the search radius, including distance from the center point.

code.description: Postal/ZIP code of the matched location.

region.description: Region, state, or province associated with the postal code.

city.description: City associated with the postal code.

district.description: District or neighborhood associated with the postal code. Can be an empty string when no district-level data exists.

distance.description: Distance from the center point to this postal code, in the unit specified by the unit parameter.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
